'''Star Wars: Clone Wars Gambit''' is a two-part [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel series that ties in to the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. It comprises the stories ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'' and ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]'' by author [[Karen Miller]]. They were published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2010]].
